name: genome-gene-counts-and-busco-are-read-from-the-organism-record
turns: list plasmodium falciparum genomes in veupathdb, number of annotated genes, and busco scores for each
rationale: Gene counts and BUSCO scores are columns of the organism record. The turn reads them with read_search_table and states the numbers; it does not say BUSCO must come from assembly reports.

provenance.curatorNote: 5720 is the gene count of P. falciparum 3D7 and 98.3% its genomic BUSCO completeness on the QA portal.
